**1B.6: Resistance to proliferation by allies, proxies, clients, or domestic factions**

Best reading: **weak-to-moderate support, mostly by absence and by Vietnam’s public nonproliferation posture, with no clear counterevidence of Trọng tolerating proliferation for short-term gain.** I found no reliable 2024 reporting that any ally, proxy, client, or domestic faction was pursuing proliferation in a way Trọng had to resist. The closest evidence is Vietnam’s explicit support for arms control and nonproliferation in the June 2024 Vietnam-Russia statement.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Support | [Viet Nam-Russia issue Joint Statement](https://en.baochinhphu.vn/viet-nam-russia-issue-joint-statement-111240625132431373.htm) | Government of Viet Nam (English portal) | 2024-06-25 | https://en.baochinhphu.vn/viet-nam-russia-issue-joint-statement-111240625132431373.htm | Vietnam explicitly backed arms control, disarmament, nonproliferation, NPT review, CTBT work, SEANWFZ consultation, and BWC/CWC implementation. This is the best evidence that the 2024 state line under Trọng favored nonproliferation rather than tolerating it for advantage. | `1B.6` `1B.4` |
| Support | [Viet Nam deeply concerned about tension escalation in Middle East](https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/vietnam-deeply-concerned-about-tension-escalation-in-middle-east-4734359.html) | VnExpress International / Reuters | 2024-04-14 | https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/vietnam-deeply-concerned-about-tension-escalation-in-middle-east-4734359.html | Vietnam called for restraint, peaceful settlement, and compliance with international law after regional escalation. This is broader de-escalation evidence consistent with resisting proliferation incentives, though not direct proof of factional resistance. | `1B.6` `1B.4` |
| Support | [Vietnam PM says arms expo is a message of peace, cooperation and development](https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-pm-says-arms-expo-is-a-message-of-peace-cooperation-and-development/2409783/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-12-19 | https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-pm-says-arms-expo-is-a-message-of-peace-cooperation-and-development/2409783/ | Vietnam framed defense cooperation as a way to “build trust and prevent wars” and reiterated the “four no” policy, including no use of force or threat of force. That is supportive of a nonproliferation/anti-escalation posture. | `1B.6` `1B.4` |
| Weak counterevidence | [Russia’s Putin in Vietnam seeks new “security architecture”](https://theprint.in/world/russias-putin-in-vietnam-seeks-new-security-architecture/2139953/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-06-20 | https://theprint.in/world/russias-putin-in-vietnam-seeks-new-security-architecture/2139953/ | Vietnam hosted Putin and signed agreements including energy cooperation. This shows pragmatic balancing with a war-linked partner, but it does not show tolerating proliferation by allies or proxies. | `1B.6` |
| Weak counterevidence | [Yellen says US ties with Vietnam don’t require it to sever ties with Russia, China](https://theprint.in/world/yellen-says-us-ties-with-vietnam-dont-require-it-to-sever-ties-with-russia-china/2140291/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-06-20 | https://theprint.in/world/yellen-says-us-ties-with-vietnam-dont-require-it-to-sever-ties-with-russia-china/2140291/ | Reuters noted that Putin’s visit included oil, gas, and nuclear-science agreements. This is evidence of pragmatic balancing, not of encouraging proliferation. | `1B.6` `1B.4` `1B.5` |

**Search gap**
- I found **no reliable 2024 evidence** that Trọng had to suppress allies, proxies, clients, or domestic factions seeking nuclear or other proliferation.
- I also found **no evidence** that he enabled such behavior for political convenience.
- So the best-supported judgment is that 2024 shows **nonproliferation-leaning state policy**, but the specific “resist proliferation by allies/proxies/factions” subquestion has **little direct observational evidence** in the record.
